query:
-- Every group of a tenant, oldest first, each with only those of its roles
-- among the given ones: the tree, and what in it can make an
-- administrator.
SELECT g.id, g.name, g.origin, g.parent_id,
       ARRAY(
           SELECT gr.role_id
           FROM group_roles gr
           WHERE gr.tenant_id = g.tenant_id AND gr.group_id = g.id AND gr.role_id = ANY($2)
           ORDER BY gr.position
       ) AS "role_ids!",
       g.created_at, g.updated_at
FROM groups g
WHERE g.tenant_id = $1
ORDER BY g.created_at, g.id
